evidence.curator_note: First arrow of Equation 8.57, labelled 'alpha'. Generic scheme: a pyrrolidine ring carrying R on nitrogen and R' on the ring carbon two bonds away from N (position 3, as drawn: the R'-bearing vertex is bonded to the N-adjacent vertex, not to N itself). The molecular ion is n-ionized at nitrogen ('+.' drawn over N); alpha-cleavage forms the N=C2 iminium head and breaks the C2-C3 ring bond, giving the ring-opened distonic ion CH2=N+(R)-CH2CH2-.CH(R') that the page draws as the middle structure (radical dot on the R'-bearing carbon). Book draws 2 arcs: move <1> is the small drawn fishhook from the N+. odd electron into the forming N=C2 pi bond and move <2> is the large drawn fishhook from the breaking C2-C3 sigma bond into that same pi bond; move <3> (the other C2-C3 sigma electron onto C3) is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page, although the product radical dot is shown). INSTANTIATION: R = H, R' = CH3 (3-methylpyrrolidine, M+. m/z 85.089), the first of the two substitution patterns tabulated under the equation; the m/z values encoded here therefore derive from that curator-chosen instantiation.

Second arrow of Equation 8.57, also labelled 'alpha': the C3 radical of the ring-opened ion forms the C3=C4 pi bond and the C4-C5 bond breaks, expelling the neutral alkene CH2=CH-R' (propene for R' = CH3, drawn at the right of the equation) and leaving the odd-electron ion .CH2-N+(R)=CH2 - m/z 43, 100% for R = H, R' = CH3; the page also tabulates R = CH3, R' = H : m/z 57, 80% (the same ion skeleton with an N-methyl, m/z 57.058). Book draws 2 arcs, both terminating on the forming C3=C4 bond: move <1> (the C3 radical's odd electron, drawn from the dot) and move <2> (one electron of the breaking C4-C5 sigma bond); move <3> (the other C4-C5 electron onto C5) is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page, although the product radical dot on the N-CH2 is shown). DELOCALIZATION: the surrounding text states that in such ions the unpaired electron is stabilized by allylic resonance, .CR2-Y+=CR'2 <-> CR2=Y+-CR'2; one localized form is encoded consistently (radical on C5, iminium N1=C2), which is the form drawn on the page.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no entry for 8.57 (its chapter-8 keys stop at 8.14); no MØD rule variable is cross-linked to this scheme. The only indexed ring-fragmentation family, IMS_8_6_1..IMS_8_6_4, works on an all-carbon cyclooctadiene-type ring with no heteroatom, so it does NOT describe this nitrogen alpha ring-opening and is not cross-linked. The page prints the two tabulated abundances as bare percentages without naming the experiment; they are the book's standard 70 eV EI values (the text cites Duffield et al. 1965 for the pyrrolidine spectrum), and ms_context is set accordingly.
